model: FUTURA L / M / S heat recovery ventilation unit (Modbus TCP)
applies_to: Futura L/M/S from firmware FUA.P.06.71, register list v5.0 (13.10.2025). Futura L+ uses different addresses and is not covered.
summary: The FUTURA is a residential heat recovery ventilation unit with a built-in Modbus TCP server. Input registers give air temperatures, humidity, fan data, power and connected room-sensor values; holding registers set the ventilation mode, timed functions, setpoints and external sensor values. This page lists the 16-bit registers of the Futura L/M/S layout.

addressing.note: Addresses are printed as protocol addresses and start at 0 (input register 0 is the product ID), so they are sent unchanged.

source.title: JABLOTRON FUTURA MODBUS TCP
source.pages: p. 1 (server settings, input registers), pp. 2-3 (input registers), pp. 4-5 (holding registers), pp. 6-9 (bit tables)

notes: Jablotron does not appear to host this list publicly; the link is the unaltered maker document as mirrored by the integrator TapHome.

Left out: every 32-bit register (serial number, firmware revision, operation-mode, error and warning words at 16-21, away start/end timestamps, Modbus counters, connected-device masks). The list does not say which register holds the high word.

Left out: preferred humidity (holding 11), whose unit is printed as 0.1 % while its values are listed as 25/50/75; the backup battery voltage (unit printed as 0.001 mV); the per-device options bit registers; sensor corrections; external sensor invalidate and floor temperature; external buttons; and the service/password registers 900-922.

Wall UI blocks repeat every 5 registers from 100 (3 units), wall sensors every 5 from 115 (8 units), ALFA units every 10 from 160 (8 units). External sensor values written by the master repeat every 10 from 300 (8 sensors). The zone CO2/temperature block at 100-173 exists only on the L+ and is not listed.

integration.summary: Connect over Modbus TCP to port 502, unit ID 1. Read input registers 30-48 with function 04 for temperatures, humidity and fans, and write holding register 0 for the ventilation mode or 1-5 to start timed boost, circulation, overpressure, night or party functions.
integration.enable: The Modbus TCP server is built in; no enable step is documented.
quirks: Only one TCP socket is available. A second client (another BMS or app gateway) blocks the connection.
Multi-register values must be read or written in one request (function 03/04, or 16 to write); a partial read returns ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS.
gotchas: The Futura L+ uses a different, shorter address layout; do not use these addresses on an L+.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
